reason: Free listing is fine, my friend can deal with it, but I won't pay. Instagram already fills the room and the PR guys do the lists, so I don't see what a paid plan adds for me.
objection: My competitors will be on it too, so what do I gain? 500 people on a waitlist is nothing next to my Instagram, and I'm not paying for a badge when the venue next door has the same one.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that the app brings people who actually walk in my door, like a few hundred real users in my city checking my nights, and something that sets me apart from the other bars, such as being exclusive in my area.
